rationale: C24 is a clear, concrete drafting template for the child. Both memoranda use nearly the same four-part progression: announce the annual nationwide appeals among Federal civilian and military personnel; identify the Red Cross, USO, and disease-fighting organizations; state the Government's desire to assume its citizen share and describe the campaigns as the opportunity to do so; then appoint Neil H. McElroy as Vice Chairman, request cooperation, and encourage generous employee giving. The child substantially compresses and lightly revises C24 while updating the fundraising total. C15 and C08 are strong earlier iterations of the same recurring text, but C24 is closest in wording, personnel, and structure.

shared_material.child_excerpt: United Funds and Community Chests will make their annual appeals this fall throughout the country and among Federal civilian and military personnel.
shared_material.parent_excerpt: United funds and Community Chests will soon be making their annual appeals throughout the country and among federal civilian and military personnel.
shared_material.explanation: Near-verbatim opening sentence with only minor changes in timing and syntax.

shared_material.child_excerpt: Many of these campaigns will include such national agencies as the American National Red Cross, the United Service Organizations (USO), as well as others working to eliminate disease and secure the health of us all.
shared_material.parent_excerpt: Many of these campaigns include such national charities as the Red Cross, USO, and others working to eliminate disease and secure the health of us all.
shared_material.explanation: Distinctive shared enumeration and identical closing phrase indicate direct reuse.

shared_material.child_excerpt: We, in Government, want to assume our full citizen's share of this great charitable work. The United Fund and Community Chest campaigns provide us with an opportunity for doing this.
shared_material.parent_excerpt: We, in Government, want to assume our full share of the support of private health and welfare services. The United fund and Community Chest campaigns provide each of us with an opportunity to participate in a wide variety and number of voluntary organizations.
shared_material.explanation: The child preserves the same two-sentence rhetorical and functional unit while simplifying its wording.

shared_material.child_excerpt: The Honorable Neil H. McElroy, Secretary of Defense, will serve as Vice Chairman of the United Community Campaigns for the Federal government throughout the country. I am confident everyone will cooperate gladly with him in these campaigns.
shared_material.parent_excerpt: The Honorable Neff H. McElroy, Secretary of Defense, will serve as Vice Chairman of United Community Campaigns for the federal Government. I am sure everyone will extend full cooperation to him
shared_material.explanation: Same named official, office, campaign role, and immediate request for cooperation; the apparent first-name discrepancy in C24 is a textual error rather than a substantive difference.

shared_material.child_excerpt: It is my hope that employees of your department--in each community where it conducts its operations--will give thoughtfully and generously to these campaigns.
shared_material.parent_excerpt: I hope the employees of your department or agency will give generously to these campaigns.
shared_material.explanation: The child expands C24's closing appeal but retains its specific object, audience, and operative wording.
